BackstoryDef.title: vault-born specimen
BackstoryDef.description: Taken from a cryogenically frozen vault as an infant, [PAWN_nameDef] grew up beneath the surface inside a gleaming subterranean research complex. Surrounded by scientists who viewed [PAWN_possessive] uncorrupted DNA as humanity's future, [PAWN_pronoun] never knew life on the ruined surface.

BackstoryDef.title: director of the institute
BackstoryDef.description: Ascending to lead the Institute through decades of secretive research, [PAWN_nameDef] views the irradiated wasteland above as a doomed relic beyond saving. Calm, paternal, and ruthlessly utilitarian, [PAWN_pronoun] believes only underground science can redefine humanity.

BackstoryDef.title: subterranean hall monitor
BackstoryDef.description: Raised in the spotless corridors of the Institute, [PAWN_nameDef] always took rules, security clearances, and surveillance logs far more seriously than [PAWN_possessive] peers. [PAWN_pronoun] loved catching classmates slipping into restricted labs.

BackstoryDef.title: retention bureau chief
BackstoryDef.description: As acting head of the Synth Retention Bureau, [PAWN_nameDef] treats escaped synths as stolen property and surface dwellers as dangerous savages. Suspicious, arrogant, and fiercely loyal to internal security, [PAWN_pronoun] dispatches hunters to reclaim every rogue asset.

BackstoryDef.title: courser conditioning subject
BackstoryDef.description: Shaped from [PAWN_possessive] earliest activation inside sterile tactical simulation chambers, [PAWN_nameDef] was conditioned to suppress hesitation, fear, and sympathy. Every hour was spent mastering close-quarters combat, infiltration, and target tracking.

BackstoryDef.title: elite institute courser
BackstoryDef.description: An emotionless, black-coated operative of the Retention Bureau, [PAWN_nameDef] hunts rogue synths and eliminates threats to the Institute with lethal efficiency. Cold, analytical, and relentless, [PAWN_pronoun] treats every mission as a problem to be solved without mercy.

BackstoryDef.title: ambitious physics student
BackstoryDef.description: Growing up with an insatiable hunger for pre-war engineering and energy theory, [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] youth dismantling salvaged fusion cores and reactor schematics. [PAWN_pronoun] possessed little patience for small talk or people who slowed down [PAWN_possessive] work.

BackstoryDef.title: advanced systems director
BackstoryDef.description: After helping bring clean water to the Capital Wasteland and growing disillusioned with military politics, [PAWN_nameDef] joined the Institute to lead its Advanced Systems division. Sharp-tongued and fiercely dedicated to pure science, [PAWN_pronoun] pushes experimental energy projects forward.

BackstoryDef.title: hardened frontier drifter
BackstoryDef.description: Born into a broken home on the western coast, [PAWN_nameDef] learned early that the strong take what they want while the weak get buried. Armed with a heavy revolver before [PAWN_pronoun] was grown, [PAWN_pronoun] drifted eastward taking bloody mercenary contracts.

BackstoryDef.title: cybernetic surface enforcer
BackstoryDef.description: After losing everyone [PAWN_pronoun] ever loved, [PAWN_nameDef] sold [PAWN_possessive] conscience to the Institute in exchange for life-extending cybernetic implants. Cold, fatalistic, and deadly with a .44 revolver, [PAWN_pronoun] carries out the Institute's dirtiest surface operations.

BackstoryDef.title: curious tinkerer
BackstoryDef.description: Raised in the quiet residential quarters of the Institute, [PAWN_nameDef] spent hours assembling intricate mechanical toys and studying synthetic muscle fibers. Unlike more dogmatic peers, [PAWN_pronoun] felt genuine empathy for everything [PAWN_pronoun] built.

BackstoryDef.title: robotics division chief
BackstoryDef.description: As head of the Robotics division, [PAWN_nameDef] oversees the assembly and refinement of synthetic humans with quiet pride and growing moral doubt. Gentle, thoughtful, and brilliant, [PAWN_pronoun] secretly believes third-generation synths deserve to be treated as living beings.
